sop_title: Clearing Temporary Files to Resolve Disk Full on orders-api
purpose: To free up disk space on the orders-api deployment when the /var/lib/shoplite partition hits 100% capacity due to accumulated temporary files.
when_to_use: Use this procedure when the OrdersApiDiskFull alert fires or when health checks report failing disk and OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device occurs.
prerequisites: Kubernetes CLI (kubectl) access to the shop namespace
Network access to call the orders-api health endpoint

steps.instruction: Check the disk usage to confirm the problem.
Clear temporary files to free up disk space.
steps.expect: Temporary files older than one day are deleted.

steps.instruction: Check the health status to confirm the fix.

verification: Verify disk usage df -h output shows reduced usage on /var/lib/shoplite
Verify health check endpoint returns status ok

rollback.instruction: Deleted temporary files cannot be undone because they are permanent deletions of expired temporary data. Ensure application stability and regenerate files if necessary.

sop_change: Created a new SOP since no internal SOP previously covered this disk full issue.
rca_title: Orders-api Disk Full Due to Accumulated Temporary Receipt Files
short_description: Disk space exhaustion on orders-api due to uncleaned temporary PDF receipt files.
problem_statement: The orders-api service encountered an OSError [Errno 28] No space left on device while attempting to write a temporary PDF receipt, resulting in a degraded health status with a failing disk.
impact: The orders-api deployment suffered a disk full condition on /var/lib/shoplite, preventing the creation of new temporary receipt files and degrading system health.
trigger: Accumulation of temporary PDF receipt files in /var/lib/shoplite/tmp exceeding the partition storage capacity.
immediate_resolution: Deleted temporary files older than one day from the /var/lib/shoplite/tmp directory inside the orders-api deployment.
root_causes: Temporary PDF receipt files in /var/lib/shoplite/tmp were not automatically cleaned up, eventually consuming 100% of the disk space.

timeline.event: Engineer encountered OSError [Errno 28] No space left on device for receipt-8812.pdf and health check showed disk failure.
Engineer asked about the safety of step 2 and received confirmation that it only deletes files older than 24 hours.
Engineer completed the remediation steps and reported done.

action_items: Implement an automated cleanup cron job or lifecycle policy for /var/lib/shoplite/tmp to prevent accumulation of old temporary files.
